description: This Kotlin file defines a Fragment for the music player app's library screen, managing playlist display and creation.

classes.name: LibraryFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays user's music playlists, allows creating new playlists, and observes playlist data updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view and binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the playlist RecyclerView, button click listener, and launches coroutine to observe playlist data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the view binding to prevent memory leaks.
